Row.Text: +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold from every resource worked by the city. City must be built on the coast.
[NEWLINE]"Ideas, like large rivers, never have just one source."[NEWLINE] - Willy Ley[NEWLINE]

The Amphawa Floating Market is a market located in the Amphawa district of Bangkok. It is famous worldwide for it's excellent portrayal of the Floating market which is seen across South-East Asia. It is one of Bangkok's most famous floating markets, and is seen by thousands of merchants and visitors monthly.
